stem.text: A student mixed $25.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $4.00\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid with an equal volume of $4.00\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide. The initial temperature of both solutions was $15.0\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. The maximum temperature recorded was $30.0\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$. The heat capacity of the final solution can be assumed to be $4.18\,\text{J K}^{-1}\text{g}^{-1}$ and the density of this solution can be assumed to be $1.00\,\text{g cm}^{-3}$.
Using these results, what is the enthalpy change of neutralisation of hydrochloric acid?
